about: Minimum-aberration 2^(k-p) fractions of 12 to 50 factors in 64 and 128 runs, written by scripts/minimum_aberration_table.py. Each size is a string of generator words over the base factors A, B, ..., one for each added factor in turn (G, H, J, ... after Z come a, b, ...). A search found them; each has the word-length pattern of the minimum-aberration design of the published, exhaustive catalogs, which the tests check.
sources: Chen, Sun and Wu (1993), International Statistical Review 61, 131-145: 64 runs, resolution IV (12 to 32 factors).
Mee (2009), A Comprehensive Guide to Factorial Two-Level Experimentation, Appendix G: 64 runs, 33 to 37 factors.
Xu (2009), Technometrics 51, 262-277: 128 runs, up to 24 factors.
Block and Mee (2005), Journal of Quality Technology 37, 282-293, with corrigendum 38 (2006) 196: 128 runs, 25 to 64 factors.
64 runs, 38 to 50 factors: FrF2's catalog, from a duplicated 32-run minimum-aberration design and complementary design theory (Mee, 2009, Section 6.2.2).
